# University of Iowa Design System (UIDS)

> A design system for the University of Iowa. Its docs site, https://uids.brand.uiowa.edu/, is a Storybook app that needs JavaScript; the page below is plain text, written from the same design tokens.

## Typography

- [UIDS typography](https://uids.brand.uiowa.edu/typography.md): the hierarchy each format takes (X-Small, Small, Medium, Large or X-Large), and each hierarchy's type styles in px and pt, with their CSS classes.
